dashboard.description: MariaDB master/slave and MongoDB: actual systemd service state, Node Exporter server metrics and Alloy/Loki logs. Database-specific exporter metrics are not yet collected.

options.content:
### CulturePick / Database operations
**MariaDB master** `[IP_REDACTED]` | **MariaDB slave** `[IP_REDACTED]` | **MongoDB** `[IP_REDACTED]` (identified by mongod.service metrics).

Service state comes from Node Exporter systemd metrics; exporter scrape status is separate. CPU, memory, filesystem and I/O describe the whole server. **No logs in 24h does not mean a database is down**; a quiet journal or file can also produce no logs.

**DB internals are not collected yet:** replication lag, DB connections and query/operation rates require mysqld_exporter / mongodb_exporter. Node Exporter and Alloy logs alone cannot supply these values. See the setup notes at the bottom.

**Log availability:** MariaDB master, MariaDB slave and MongoDB logs have all been verified in Loki. MongoDB file read access for Alloy was repaired on 2026-11-06. Log panels display operational logs, not records stored in your databases.

options.content:
### Add DB-specific exporters to collect database internals
1. **MariaDB:** run prometheus/mysqld_exporter on master and slave (usually port 9104), using a dedicated monitoring user. Enable global_status and slave_status collectors. Add both endpoints to Prometheus. Replication lag and IO/SQL replication threads are meaningful on the slave.
2. **MongoDB:** run percona/mongodb_exporter on [IP_REDACTED] (usually port 9216), using clusterMonitor on admin and read on local. Add its endpoint to Prometheus. Replica-set replication metrics require an actual replica set.
3. Check /metrics, Prometheus Targets, then mysql_up / mongodb_up. Inspect actual metric names before adding connections, query/operation rates and replication panels. No database exporter has been installed or configured by this dashboard creation.
4. For missing logs: verify Alloy journal access / MongoDB log file read permission, the running collector configuration, Loki forwarding and labels. Empty logs alone do not establish a collector failure.

References: [mysqld_exporter](https://github.com/prometheus/mysqld_exporter) / [mongodb_exporter](https://github.com/percona/mongodb_exporter)
